# ActorRating — extended notes for AI agents

Short summary: https://actorrating.com/llms.txt  
Methodology (canonical scoring rules): https://actorrating.com/methodology  
Sitemap index: https://actorrating.com/sitemap.xml

## Product

ActorRating rates **performances** (an actor in a movie), not films as a whole. Users may rate as guests or signed-in; **public community averages use signed-in ratings only**.

## Scoring (do not invent numbers)

1. Each rating scores five criteria (0–100 in storage). Live UI labels: Emotional Impact; Character Depth; Technical Skill; Screen Presence; Originality.
2. A single rating’s score is the mean of those five dimensions.
3. The community score for a pair is the mean of signed-in ratings, shown on a 0–10 scale (one decimal).
4. Hub ranking among roles on a film may apply a Bayesian pull toward the film prior (m=5) for **sort order only**; displayed averages remain the plain community avg when count &gt; 0.
5. Zero signed-in ratings → no community aggregate; UI copy is “Be the first to rate” (or equivalent).

Full detail: https://actorrating.com/methodology

## URL grammar

| Type | Pattern |
|------|---------|
| Actor | `/actors/{slug}` |
| Movie | `/movies/{slug}` |
| Rate / performance | `/rate/{movieSlug}/{actorSlug}` |
| Best-performances hub | `/movies/{slug}/best-performances` (allowlist-gated) |

Example hub: https://actorrating.com/movies/the-odyssey-2026/best-performances

## What not to crawl as primary content

Disallowed or private: `/api/*`, `/admin/*`, `/auth/*`, `/dashboard`, `/profile`, `/onboarding`, `/search`.

## Data provenance

Cast/filmography metadata may originate from TMDB (with attribution on-site). Community craft scores are ActorRating-only.

## robots.txt policy

See https://actorrating.com/robots.txt. Search/user AI bots and (by default) training bots are allowed the public corpus; training allow is controlled by `AI_TRAINING_ALLOWED` in code.

This file is hand-maintained from product rules (not a live DB dump). Prefer `/methodology` and on-page numbers for citations.

Last updated: 2026-10-22
